advisories.detail: 24 native records resolve generic reference roles through preserved prompts. New p44-v3 has explicit semantic roles for all five references. Prompt-mediated roles are traceable but less convenient for machine reading.
The selected p12 core is a disclosed bounded local RGB correction of p12-v3. It remains native spatial resolution but must not be described as wholly untouched image_gen pixels.
Pixel coverage/provenance do not confer seam acceptance, geometric correctness, client mapping, or 5000-player capacity. Current candidate formalAccepted is false and externalSeams is unverified.

failedAttempt.historicalHashEvidenceNote: The failed request itself has paths but no inline reference hashes. Its first five input hashes are present in preserved p12-v2 generation.json; the sixth local tile guide hash is present in p11-v1 generation.json. Current files match those historical successful-call records. No native output or generation record is expected for a rejected no-image call.

candidates.layoutGuideClaimScope: All delivered pixels exactly equal native tool-output core pixels or the disclosed native color correction. This proves no mechanical guide insertion, not that AI retained no blurry reference appearance.

resolvedFindings.impact: All 16 destination boxes contain six values. Standard Image.crop(box) consumers fail with ValueError: too many values to unpack (expected 4). Candidate pixels nevertheless match every independent four-value destination exactly.
resolvedFindings.cause: PIL Image.paste mutates the passed list at from [x,y] into [x,y,x+1024,y+1024]; serializing [*at,at[0]+1024,at[1]+1024] appends the end coordinates a second time.
resolvedFindings.suggestedFix: Pass tuple(at) to paste and serialize destination with four explicit coordinates. Rebuild only metadata/candidate as needed; preserve the same image SHA.
resolvedFindings.resolution: All 16 arrays now contain the correct 4 coordinates. assemble_candidate.py passes tuple(at) to paste. Candidate SHA and all 16 pixel cores unchanged at the correction checkpoint.
